name: KNIFE MILL
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-KM-200 Knife Mill (Blender) is predominantly used in agriculture, food testing, and forensic laboratories. It is engineered for the rapid size reduction and homogenization of soft, elastic, fibrous, and high-moisture samples like meat, plant leaves, seeds, and chocolate. It features interval, regular, and reverse modes for optimal mixing.
features: Razor-sharp blades (Stainless Steel or Titanium coating/alloy)
High-speed motor adjustable from 500 up to 10000 rpm (Model dependent)
Coarse grinding and fine grinding realized in one step
Electromagnetic safety lid lock prevents opening during grinding
Supports dry as well as wet grinding applications

specifications.Operational Modes: Interval mode, Reverse mode, Press-and-play mode
specifications.Target Applications: Food Testing, Agriculture, Forensics, Meat & Plant Homogenization
